column1: # Expected after m18.3 (IPv6 parity). Same as after-m18.2 plus the E rows.
# The run has IPv6 enabled on the compose network (README, "IPv6 for the after-m18.3 run"), so E1 must read
# present and E2 through E4 must read rejected. A stack with IPv6 absent fails this file on purpose; it is covered
# by after-m18.2. E5 stays open because ::1 is the one IPv6 address the sandbox keeps and nothing listens on 53.
